data.description:
The two screens that close chain link 6, "freelancer sees it paid". Dashboard: the freelancer's invoices and contracts with status. Invoice detail: full status, amounts, due date, and the Stripe-hosted links (hosted_invoice_url, invoice_pdf) surfaced for the freelancer to open or copy. Built to AS-30's wireframes and states ledgers, consuming the AS-29 tokens.

IMPLEMENTS: docs/engineering/00-d1-v1-milestone-plan.md section 3 rows C-37 (dashboard / list) and C-38 (invoice detail and status); section 4.3 screens 3 and 5 of 7.

DECISION CONTEXT. Merged as one task with a written justification (milestone plan section 8.2): one reviewable claim — "the freelancer can see what they have sent and whether it is paid" — at around 450 projected lines. Status comes from the invoice mirror the webhook task syncs; these screens read our own records and never call Stripe live. The hosted links are SURFACED, NOT REBUILT: our own invoice PDF (row C-30) and our own payment page (row C-34) are OUT under Rule 2, because Stripe's are the product here and building parallel implementations is exactly what Rule 2 forbids — the spike measured our own invoice PDF renderer at 107 lines and 0.194 ms and still found it unnecessary.

VERIFICATION: states ledger exercised — no invoices yet, loading, populated, stale/unsynced, error; status transitions render correctly from fixture mirror records; renders at 375px before desktop; tokens only, no magic values.

NOT IN THIS TASK: invoice creation (the invoice-UI task); contract screens (the contract-UI task); reminder configuration or a manual re-send control (rows C-39 and C-40, OUT — Rule 1; Stripe's own reminder cadences ride on the connected account at zero cost to us and are configured by the freelancer in their own Stripe Dashboard); analytics or reporting (row C-56, OUT); an account-settings screen (row C-41, OUT).

data.body: Plan written (Owen on Opus under the Fable fallback; tick watcher:79108 loop tick 9): .lattice/plans/task_01M1D34P63WC2P2CYJ3N65W5H1.md. Five decisions: (1) a row reaches its detail screen through a GET form with a hidden id and a UUID-shape redirector (GET /invoices/view, GET /contracts/view -> 303), never an href interpolation — P2a has no exception and AS-47 already refused an id in an href; (2) GET / is the Dashboard for every signed-in freelancer, ready or not — AS-70's interim 303 /connect-stripe is deleted, its six screens.test.js cases rewritten to a terminus of / at 200 with the gated note, and S2-RETURN-READY's 'Continue to Dashboard' control lands (AS-70's hand-off); (3) status from the mirror through one closed STATUS_BADGES table shared by list and detail — void/uncollectible/finalized-unsent render inside S5-DEFAULT-OPEN with their own badge (ledger gap for Jonah); (4) send from the detail page is POST /invoices/send with a hidden id calling the same lifecycle.send, failure -> ?error=send presence flag layered on the unchanged state; (5) the two hosted Stripe links render as escaped text to open or copy, not anchors (P2a; the redirector-to-external-URL alternative is an open-redirect surface — rejected; validated-origin anchor named as the follow-up with its trigger). Partitions 3+1+1+1+1=7 and 5+1+1+1+2=10; 28 ACs, 14 recipes, 27 named cases in a new test/read-screens.test.js. Baseline taken on master 61d8b3f: 451/433/0/18, 'Image asc-plan-as48-owen-test Built', torn down, leak check clean — and my asc-plan-as49 leftovers (two images via compose down, the stripe-mock container by name since compose no longer claimed it) are gone; other lanes' images untouched. Predicted vs today's master 478/460/0/18; at review after AS-47 (+10) and AS-49 (+7, skipped 19) ≈ 495/476/0/19. Merge order AS-47 -> AS-49 -> AS-48; seams: routes/contracts.js registration order (view before :id), contract-detail.ejs nav anchor, every §0.2 literal (ALL_ROUTES +4, VIEWS +2, harness +1, source +5, money row +2, expectFiles 8/7), and AS-49's e2e-loop AC-2 which pins the interim 303 /connect-stripe at a3619a8 lines 178-185 — AS-48 amends it at rebase. Split line 1,500 changed lines at Unit A (see it) / Unit B (send from detail = AS-48b). Complexity medium. Marcus implements (free once AS-47's review is Ruben's; his AS-47 visual.mjs is the §5 recipe), Priya reviews (after AS-49's), Ruben as the fallback if the two reviews collide. Branch feat/AS-48-read-views linked, worktree .worktrees/AS-48 added from 61d8b3f. Not run: lattice status (orchestrator moves to planned with --no-auto-review).
